children: CBOT soybean November contract (SX26) may test the support at $13.07-1/4 per bushel, a break below which could open the way toward $12.97-1/4 to $13.01-1/4 range.
A retracement analysis on the rise from $12.91-3/4 to $13.32 reveals a break below the support at $13.12, the 50% level. The next support will be at $13.07-1/4.
Given that the support at $13.12 caused a strong bounce, the support at $13.07-1/4 may trigger another one. The contract may fail to break the latter at its first attempt.

A break above $13.12, now a resistance, may lead to a gain into $13.16-3/4 to $13.22-1/2 range. On the daily chart, the contract failed a few times to break a resistance at $13.31-3/4, the 123.6% projection level of a wave c from $11.65-1/4.
The failures suggest the dissipation of the bullish momentum. The contract may retrace into the range of $12.81-1/2 to $13.
